scripts.build: npm run build-all && npm run consolidate
scripts.build-all: npm run build-aca && npm run build-channie && npm run build-cissi && npm run build-piya && npm run build-cally
scripts.build-aca: cd "aca card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-channie: cd "channie card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-cissi: cd "cissi card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-piya: cd "piya card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-cally: cd "cally card" && npm install && npm run build
scripts.consolidate: shx rm -rf public && shx mkdir -p public/aca public/channie public/cissi public/piya public/cally && shx cp index.html style.css logo.webp public/ && shx cp -r "aca card/dist/"* public/aca/ && shx cp -r "channie card/dist/"* public/channie/ && shx cp -r "cissi card/dist/"* public/cissi/ && shx cp -r "piya card/dist/"* public/piya/ && shx cp -r "cally card/dist/"* public/cally/
